author: Various Ansible project contributors
description: When the current role is being executed by means of an M(include_role) or M(import_role) action, this variable contains a list of all parent roles, with the most recent role (in other words, the role that included/imported this role) being the first item in the list.

When multiple inclusions occur, this list lists the I(last) role (in other words, the role that included this role) as the I(first) item in the list. It is also possible that a specific role exists more than once in this list.
For example: When role B(A) includes role B(B), inside role B, C(ansible_parent_role_names) will equal to C(['A']). If role B(B) then includes role B(C), the list becomes C(['B', 'A']).

author: Various Ansible project contributors
description: When the current role is being executed by means of an M(include_role) or M(import_role) action, this variable contains a list of all parent roles paths, with the most recent role (in other words, the role that included/imported this role) being the first item in the list.
Please refer to C(ansible_parent_role_names) for the order of items in this list.
